title: The Secret Workshop and the Silver Star
moral: Respect and kindness guide the right path.

scenes.text: Maya discovers a map in her attic leading to hidden treasure.

story: Maya and Isla follow a mysterious map through their town solving riddles and meeting helpful people. In the end, they find a silver star and learn that respect, kindness, and curiosity are the real treasures.
